body: INDEPENDENT SECOND REVIEW of ADR 0003 candidate 1dc6666: ACCEPT; both requested questions are clean. Q1 - no carrier law is wrong for carriers I have implemented. Feature Estimate correctly distinguishes Observed from typed Missing, and Coverage is lawful only when its observed/eligible counts are the estimand's actual grain; the ADR explicitly preserves that boundary instead of making Coverage universal. For sidecars, the physical SM4SFT02 layout/blocked-byte codec is not itself a scientific estimand, while SidecarTrack plus FeatureCodecs transport Estimate.Missing(reason) and per-observation Coverage alongside compact observed-row references; the scientific-codec law applies at that logical seam, not to raw byte offsets. For embed receipts, AttemptReceipt/ReceiptDigest are provenance and identity carriers rather than participant estimands: private/validated construction, KeyUnavailable, and Withheld preserve absence and authority without converting them to zero; any scientific EmbedOutcome still carries Estimate. The carrier table does not force receipts into a probability/count algebra they do not have. Q2 - the amended verification wording is satisfiable without ceremonial tests. A good-faith SM4SFT02 candidate can explicitly declare obligations 1-5 inapplicable because it stores already-observed rows and has no residual distribution, trial set, or hard threshold, while obligation 6 remains load-bearing. A receipt candidate can likewise state that zero-trial and threshold obligations do not exist, while testing fail-closed key absence, exact decision/identity transport, and production mutations that do exist. Conversely, FeatureCodecs cannot call Missing round-trip inapplicable because that path exists. Requiring each omission to name the obligation and absent path gives the reviewer a concrete claim to reject; it narrows applicability without lowering evidence. One interpretive note, not a blocker: the table's word codec is scoped by the ADR opening to codecs of public scientific quantities, not every storage codec. On that reading - reinforced by the amended applicability rule - the contract advances vision/mission and does not induce irrelevant APIs or tests.
